name: candice-integration
description: Candice — local visual and voice companion for BlackCEO Claude Code skills. Wakes on /spec-protocol, /kaizen, /eli5, and /bro; provides the structured MCP interview bridge; degrades to text in the terminal whenever the companion is unavailable. Candice is the face, voice, ears, and lightweight user interface. The active Claude Code session and the invoked skill remain the brain, rules, memory, and source of truth. Candice never creates a second AI conversation, never maintains a competing project memory, and never modifies the question order or rules of Spec Protocol or Kaizen.
